_comment: home_q: the scan home in UR order [pan, lift, elbow, wrist_1, wrist_2, wrist_3], rad -
the user's elbow-up camera pose (2026-09-24, /joint_states). Its branch is the lock:
every IK solution must keep the signs of lift, elbow and wrist_2 (branch_joints).
standoff_m / clearance_m / roll_step_deg / lin_steps: the approach point above each
tack along the PEN axis; the required gap for the collision model - 3 mm: the tool
envelope already carries margin, and with the tip at 183.78 mm the holder body clears
the plates of a 90 deg T by 3.1 mm at best (63.8 * sin 45 - 42), so 5 mm would refuse
every square fillet; the roll sampling about the pen axis; the number of
Cartesian steps checked on the LIN descent.
work_angles_deg: admissible tilts of the pen off the seam's bisector, in the plane of
the two face normals (rotation about the seam tangent); 0 is the bisector. A 90 deg
corner leaves the holder 7.5 mm from both plates at 0; on plates that lean, a tilt
away from the closer plate is what makes the tack reachable. The best (tilt, roll)
per seam is the one with the largest minimum clearance, then the least joint travel.
max_joint_step_rad: the largest single-joint move allowed between consecutive tack
poses of one seam (no aggressive turns); larger -> the roll is rejected.
table_z_m: null -> no table plane (parts sit on holders well above it); set it once
